name: production-code-audit
description: Audit a codebase the way years of production use would: enumerate, understand, hunt with single-question lenses, reproduce, verify adversarially, then fix with regression tests.

interface.shortDescription: Find and prove the bugs years of production use would have found.
interface.longDescription: A phased audit that treats bug-finding as a search: enumerate and rank units, build understanding records, hunt with single-question lenses, reproduce every candidate, verify adversarially, report with coverage, then fix approved findings with regression tests. Ships five worker-agent definitions for subagent-capable hosts and a sequential fallback for the rest.
defaultPrompt: Audit this repo for production readiness and show me what will break.
Go deep on everything that touches money, auth, or the database, with proof.
